Explicit self.add is appropriate for the closure capture. No high-confidence API/type/capture defect identified by inspection; Windows source review cannot typecheck the current Apple SDK.

Deduplication reuses findings.failing.contains(line) across combined/isolated attempts, so each unique failure line receives one named ax-failure-<screen>-<index> attachment per audit. Geometry is part of line identity, so a changed-frame finding can legitimately produce another attachment.

The screenshot records callback-time visible pixels after the issue snapshot. It is stronger evidence than the initial still, but does not prove the audit algorithm measured precisely the same state/time or that the highlighted failing element is visible. Actual artifacts must still be matched to the line/bounds and reviewed before diagnosing a false positive.
